tools.name: Create a new booking
tools.description: Creates a new booking for an event type at a specified start time. Use this action to schedule a meeting with a Cal.com user. Prerequisites: 1. Get a valid event type ID from list_event_types 2. Find an available time slot using get_available_slots_info 3. Provide attendee name and email in the 'responses' object 4. Specify timezone and language preferences The booking will be created with status 'ACCEPTED' if no confirmation is required, or 'PENDING' if the event type requires host confirmation.

input.title: PostNewBookingRequestRequest

start.title: Start
start.description: Start date and time for the booking in ISO 8601 format in UTC (e.g., '2024-09-15T10:00:00Z'). Must be an available slot from get_available_slots_info.

guests.title: Guests
guests.description: List of additional guest email addresses to invite to the event.

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: Whether this is an instant booking that bypasses approval flows (team events only).

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: Routing form response data with team member IDs for assignment.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for communications with the attendee (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French).

location.title: Location
location.description: Location object matching one of the event type's configured locations (e.g., {'type': 'integrations:daily'} for Cal Video).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Custom key-value metadata for tracking or analytics. Defaults to empty object. Max 50 keys, 40 chars per key, 500 chars per value.

teamSlug.title: Team Slug
teamSlug.description: Team slug for event type identification when using eventTypeSlug.

timeZone.title: Time Zone
timeZone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the attendee (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'). This determines how times are displayed to the attendee.

username.title: Username
username.description: Username of the host for event type identification when using eventTypeSlug.

responses.title: Responses
responses.description: Attendee details object. Required keys: 'name' (string, attendee's full name) and 'email' (string, valid email address). Optional: 'smsReminderNumber' for SMS reminders.

eventTypeId.title: Event Type Id
eventTypeId.description: Unique numeric identifier of the event type to be booked. Either eventTypeId OR (eventTypeSlug + username) OR (eventTypeSlug + teamSlug) must be provided.

eventTypeSlug.title: Event Type Slug
eventTypeSlug.description: Slug of the event type. When used, must be combined with either username or teamSlug.

lengthInMinutes.title: Length In Minutes
lengthInMinutes.description: Duration of the event in minutes. Only use this when the event type supports multiple selectable durations. Omit for fixed-duration event types.

organizationSlug.title: Organization Slug
organizationSlug.description: Optional organization slug when using eventTypeSlug with username or teamSlug.

emailVerificationCode.title: Email Verification Code
emailVerificationCode.description: Email verification code if the event type requires email verification.

bookingFieldsResponses.title: Booking Fields Responses
bookingFieldsResponses.description: Key/value responses to custom booking fields defined for the event type. Required if the event type has mandatory custom fields.

input.description:
Request schema for `PostNewBookingRequest`.

Creates a booking for an event type. Required fields:
- start: ISO 8601 datetime string in UTC (e.g., '2024-09-15T10:00:00Z')
- responses: Object with 'name' and 'email' keys for the attendee
- timeZone: IANA timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York')
- language: Language code (e.g., 'en')
- Event type identification: Either eventTypeId OR (eventTypeSlug + username) OR (eventTypeSlug + teamSlug)

Note: The 'start' time must be an available slot. Use get_available_slots_info first.
